name: zclass_cls_di_filter_regions_against_mesh_faces
description: zClass_cls_di::FilterRegionsAgainstMeshFaces caches polygon vertices and normalized XZ edge planes for region filtering.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because reverse-order zVec3 scratch writes and normalized edge-vector x87 temporaries remain expanded in HLIL.
No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this cls_di helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent cls_di source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x487900 validates the face-count guard at 64, reset of g_zModel_PointInPolygonVertexCount, reverse vertex copy, edge normal construction from next/current XZ coordinates, Vec3Normalize call, final vertex count store, and return value.
The native DI region-filter smoke verifies the over-limit guard, cached vertices, normalized edge normals for a clockwise square, and downstream hexahedron-filter use of the cached data.
